ci_support_linux_64_.yaml:
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
python_min:
- '3.10'

about.description:
Pythonlings teaches Python through 292 deliberately broken exercises across
31 topics, from variables through async. You fix the code in a built-in
terminal editor, hidden checks rerun as you type, and a passing exercise
advances you to the next one.

It is inspired by rustlings, and ships bundled offline documentation so a
learner can work without leaving the terminal.

name: pythonlings
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.4.4"

package:
  name: pythonlings
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/p/pythonlings/pythonlings-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: be8a1ebb321fb4da6ca41b1c580a690b7b9ea26e3bbfc93068e4569427e9d785

build:
  noarch: python
  number: 0
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
  python:
    entry_points:
      - pythonlings = pythonlings.cli:main

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - hatchling
    - pip
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - textual >=8.0.0
    - tomli >=1.1.0

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - pythonlings
        - pythonlings.cli
        - pythonlings.core.runner
        - pythonlings.core.manifest
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"
  - script:
      - pythonlings --version
      - pythonlings init --path plw
      - pythonlings --root plw solution variables1
    requirements:
      run:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/abhiksark/pythonlings
  summary: Learn Python by fixing tiny broken programs, in a live terminal UI.
  description: |
    Pythonlings teaches Python through 292 deliberately broken exercises across
    31 topics, from variables through async. You fix the code in a built-in
    terminal editor, hidden checks rerun as you type, and a passing exercise
    advances you to the next one.

    It is inspired by rustlings, and ships bundled offline documentation so a
    learner can work without leaving the terminal.
  license: MIT AND PSF-2.0 AND 0BSD
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - pythonlings/docs/NOTICE.md
  documentation: https://pythonlings.abhik.ai/
  repository: https://github.com/abhiksark/pythonlings

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - abhiksark
